prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a rugged, snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal region of Kaski, Nepal, under a starlit night sky. The camera advances slowly, capturing the uneven terrain composed of rocks, patches of snow, and sparse vegetation. As the viewer progresses, the path winds through a dense forest of tall, leafless trees whose dark silhouettes loom against the dimly lit backdrop. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive experience of navigating the trail. Snowflakes gently fall from above, adding a serene yet cold ambiance to the scene. The lighting is minimal, primarily sourced from the faint glow of the moon and stars, casting long shadows and creating a contrast between the illuminated areas and the deep blue-black of the night. The environment is quiet and devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the solitude of the journey. The camera continues its steady advance, occasionally tilting slightly to follow the natural contours of the trail, enhancing the sense of realism and immersion in this remote, snowy wilderness.
